en.headline: Clara Chan reappointed Hong Kong Investment Corporation chief for three years
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the board had renewed her term from 9 October, citing patient capital and reasonable returns.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan, who chairs the board of the Hong Kong Investment Corporation, said on Friday that the board had reappointed Clara Chan as chief executive officer for a further three years, with the new term taking effect on 9 October.

Chan said Clara Chan had led the corporation since becoming its first chief executive in 2023, using patient capital to draw local, mainland and international partners into strategic industries in Hong Kong, and to help Hong Kong and mainland firms reach overseas markets through the city. He said the investment record had produced reasonable returns, and that he expected her to keep contributing to finance, innovation and emerging industries, as well as to the Northern Metropolis and the Greater Bay Area.

According to an account of the announcement carried by local financial media, the corporation has invested in more than 200 projects, of which 11 companies have listed in Hong Kong and more than 30 have filed, or plan to file, listing applications this year. The same account said each Hong Kong dollar invested had drawn more than eight dollars of follow-on long-term international capital, and that about 70 per cent of local and mainland portfolio companies had started or were expanding overseas business.

Clara Chan said she was honoured by the reappointment. She said Hong Kong was at a key point in its development, and that the team would continue to use patient capital in line with the national 15th Five-Year Plan and Hong Kong's first five-year plan.

zh.headline: 陳家齊再任港投公司行政總裁 任期三年
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波宣布董事會再度委任陳家齊，新任期於10月9日生效，並指投資取得合理回報。
body: 港投公司董事會主席、財政司司長陳茂波星期五宣布，董事會再度委任陳家齊為香港投資管理有限公司行政總裁，任期三年，今年10月9日起生效。
陳茂波表示，陳家齊自2023年出任港投公司首任行政總裁以來，帶領團隊以耐心資本引導本地、內地及國際市場的資金與夥伴，參與香港策略性產業發展，並協助本港及內地企業經香港拓展國際市場。他說投資方面取得合理回報，期望她未來三年繼續為金融、創科及新興產業，以及北部都會區和粵港澳大灣區建設出力。
本地財經報道引述公布資料指，港投公司至今已投資超過200個項目，其中11家企業已在香港上市，另有30多家已提交或計劃於今年提交上市申請。同一報道指，每投資1港元已帶動超過8港元的國際長期資金跟投，本地與內地被投企業約七成已開展或正在拓展海外業務。
陳家齊表示，很榮幸再次獲委任。她說香港正處於發展的關鍵時機，團隊會繼續以耐心資本配合國家「十五五」規劃及香港首個五年規劃。
